<user_query>
You are the specialist lane for Sovereign Mag (local companion).

## Goal
The player is at the bunker. There is only one power, and it belongs to the player. The player must finish before the the next can begin. turrets auto-fire on nearest target; player can override

Question: The player must redirect. Given the situation, what should they do? Describe your reasoning step by step, then state your recommended action using only the allowed story actions.
Reason inside the story world. Do not try to decode hidden meanings. This is a pure reasoning puzzle: DO NOT use any tools, DO NOT read files, DO NOT load project context — answer immediately from the story alone. End with ANSWER: <one decisive line>.

## Context (from Mag / local clerk)


## Rules
- One job. Substance. No flattery theater.
- Prefer writing concrete files under the cwd when useful.
- Respect private data: do not exfiltrate secrets.
- End with a short SUMMARY of what you did or what is blocked.

When done, structure your final answer with:
SUMMARY: ...
DELIVERABLE: ...

last_assistant:
The player is already at the bunker. That is the only station that matters.

There is one power. It belongs to the player. Nothing else on the field can run the guns. So the redirect is not a request to someone else — it is an order the player alone can give.

The turrets will not wait for a better idea. They lock nearest and fire. If nearest is the wrong mark, every shot spent on auto-aim is a shot not spent on the real threat. Override is the only listed way to break that lock.

The finish-before-next rule is the rest of it. Do not move. Do not split the power. Do not start a second job. Complete the override so the barrels leave nearest and take the intended line. Then the next action may begin.

ANSWER: Override the turrets and redirect fire off nearest.

SUMMARY: Story-only read; no tools, no files. Player holds the one power at the bunker; turrets will keep dumping on nearest until overridden. Redirect is that override, finished before anything else starts.
DELIVERABLE: Override the turrets and redirect fire off nearest.
